messages:
alex-support: Heads-up — escalating a paying customer (acct redwood-342). They're seeing intermittent 5xxs on inference, a billing spike from retries, and missing rows in the audit log export. Repro steps included below.

casey-cs: Customer reports >1.5s latency on POST /v1/generate and occasional 401/502 during key unwrap. Request ID they shared: req_0a1b2c3d. I sent org/info in DM.

devon-eng: Can you paste the exact curl + headers we should run to repro on our side? Also which model/version and region?

alex-support: Curl we used for repro and raw logs pasted.
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" 
  -H "X-Redwood-Region: us-west2" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate 
  -d '{"model":"redwood-alpha-1","input":"test","max_tokens":32}' -v
```

Logs (excerpt):
```
2024-05-10T14:12:01Z [req_0a1b2c3d] grpc: verify key unwrap error: timeout after 500ms
2024-05-10T14:12:02Z [req_0a1b2c3d] proxy: retrying request (attempt 2)
2024-05-10T14:12:02Z [req_0a1b2c3d] backend: model-gen failed: downstream 502
2024-05-10T14:12:03Z [req_0a1b2c3d] billing: tokens_charged=128 attempts=2
```

maria-security: For ISO mapping we need to know: retention class for these audit logs, whether KMS is customer-managed HSM or platform KMS, and whether exported logs are redacted. Relevant Annex A controls: A.12.4 (logging), A.10 (cryptography), A.16 (incident). Please attach export snippet showing timestamps and kms events.

sam-sre: Observed trace + metrics: https://console.redwood/infrastructure/traces?rid=req_0a1b2c3d — proxy retries spike at 14:12 and KMS latency jumps 200->800ms. Backend returned 502 after second attempt. Looks like KMS unwrap latency cascaded to retries.

casey-cs: Customer confirmed key is customer-managed in GCP KMS and uses CloudHSM wrap/unwrap. They also requested retention proof for 7 years for compliance. Do our audit exports include KMS Admin/Access logs?

maria-security: KMS admin events live in auditlogs, but we need to verify export retention window and if they were included in the last export. I'll prepare control mapping doc. Can someone paste the actual export JSON snippet for the timeframe?

alex-support: Pasting export snippet from S3 (sanitized):
```
{"timestamp":"2024-05-10T14:11:59Z","event":"kms.key.unwrap","key_id":"projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/org-keys/cryptoKey/ck-123","request_id":"req_0a1b2c3d","status":"timeout","latency_ms":512}
{"timestamp":"2024-05-10T14:12:02Z","event":"proxy.request","request_id":"req_0a1b2c3d","attempt":2,"status":"retry"}
```

devon-eng: Quick repro notes — run the curl above with X-Redwood-Region us-west2 and trace header X-Request-Id=req_0a1b2c3d, then tail the backend logs with: 
```
kubectl logs -l app=inference -c runtime --since=2m | grep req_0a1b2c3d
```

alex-support: Also noticed billing export shows duplicate token lines tied to attempt numbers — token counts doubled because retries were charged as separate consumption events for the same logical request.

sam-sre: Short-term mitigation I propose: 1) Increase KMS client timeout to 1500ms, 2) Add a defensive dedupe in billing pipeline for retries within 10s of same request_id, 3) Route to secondary key on unwrap failure. I'll open a k8s rolling config and a billing ticket. Marking P1.

maria-security: For ISO27001 evidence we need three pieces: (1) Key management procedure and proof of CMK/HSM usage (A.10), (2) Audit logging config + retention policy showing exports (A.12.4), (3) Incident timeline + RCA draft (A.16). I'll start the mapping doc and tag legal/compliance — anyone with logs or config snippets drop them here.

incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2024-3245 — severity: P1, owner: sam-sre. Timeline tracking enabled.

casey-cs: Customer asked for ETA on mitigation. Can we promise an interim mitigation within 4 hours and a full RCA within 3 business days?

alex-support: Provided customer update: interim mitigation ETA 4 hours, full RCA 3 business days. Thanks all :pray: Will follow up with attached mapping doc from maria when ready.
